statuses.reason: The operation names no object, so ObjectNotFound has nothing to report. GET /user-defined-values and GET /webhooks take no parameters and no body. GET /communication-permissions/{permission_type} takes permission_type, an enum of channels (email, sms, phone) that request validation answers with 400, plus days and paging. The same rule as the top-level waiver for getTagsList and the other list operations.

requestBodies.Webhook names no existing object. Its id field is the webhook's own id, which a create cannot refer to, so the mock ignores it. name, url, authentication, auth_token and events are plain values. With nothing to look up, ObjectNotFound cannot be produced.
